proposals.why: rvl: 0.897, 0.051 behind hf:microsoft/dit-base-finetuned-rvlcdip (0.948), with 9600 training examples; dev plateaued at 0.89, so more of the same data may help less than new data or a new recipe. chainyo/rvl-cdip (val) has 2426 rows for its rarest label: 800 -> 2426 per label (all of it).
